prompt: Quick session check-in: I've been working on documentation for 30 minutes. I wrote an API reference for the `/users/:id` endpoint, added examples for GET and POST. I reviewed the existing docs and found 3 places where examples were outdated (`/products`, `/orders`, `/settings`). I updated products and orders but didn't have time for settings. I also realized the docs need a table of contents (not added yet). I'm getting close to running out of context. Give me a handoff doc.
